title: JournalRun
description: run.yaml — the pinned identity of a run (ARCHITECTURE.md §4). Written once at run start and never edited: a run records the workflow definition (name, version, and content digest) it starts and completes on (WF-016), plus the trigger and content-digested input snapshots.

schema.description: Version of the run identity document.

runId.description: Run identifier — the OpenTelemetry trace id for the run.

workflowDigest.description: Content digest of the pinned workflow Definition (WF-016 tamper-evident pin).

gooberDigest.description: Content digest of the participating resolved goobers, including instruction content, skills, model, and harness configuration.

continuedFromRunId.description: The terminal source run this continuation was created from.

sourceTerminalSeq.description: The immutable terminal journal sequence selected from the source run.

requestedTarget.description: Workflow state selected for the continuation.

workspaceBranch.description: Existing repository branch reused by this run.

workspaceBranchSha.description: Commit pinned for the reused branch.

contextPointers.description: Explicit continuation inputs; no ambient source context is copied.

items.description: One explicitly selected source context pointer made available to the continuation.

name.description: Artifact or context name from the source run.

branch.description: Numeric branch identifier from the source run.

branchName.description: Named branch path from the source run.

runId.description: Source run identifier for this context.

integrity.description: Provenance grade of this context pointer.

artifact.description: Immutable source artifact referenced by this context pointer.

path.description: Path to the artifact relative to the source run directory.

digest.description: SHA-256 content digest of the artifact.

mediaType.description: Optional media type describing the artifact bytes.

integrity.description: Provenance grade of the referenced artifact.

external.description: External source reference represented by this context pointer.

uri.description: Provider URI identifying the external object.

description.description: Human-readable description of the external reference.

driver.description: Component that walks the run's stages: "engine" for a run the tier-3 engine drives on Temporal. Omitted for a run the daemon's own in-process runner drives, which is every run written before this field existed.

runControls.description: Effective inherited run-control policy pinned when the run started. Omitted only on legacy journals.

maxRunDuration.description: Resolved maximum total wall-clock age of the run; omitted when disabled.

placements.description: Per-stage execution placements pinned when the run started (decision 003): the run-start solve's answer, restored verbatim on resume. Omitted when no stage was placed, which is every run written before this field existed and every run on an instance that declares no runners.

self.description: True when the stage resolved to the daemon's own host and executes in-process; omitted for a stage placed on a runner.

queue.description: Dispatch task queue the placement routes onto; omitted for a self placement.

eligible.description: Runners the run-start solve found eligible for the stage, in inventory order; dispatch consumes this set rather than re-deriving it.

hostKind.description: Classification of host: self, image, or deployment.

host.description: Raw host value: "self", an image reference, or a Deployment name.

cpu.description: Runner CPU ceiling as a Kubernetes quantity; omitted when unbounded.

memory.description: Runner memory ceiling as a Kubernetes quantity; omitted when unbounded.

disk.description: Runner disk ceiling as a Kubernetes quantity; omitted when unbounded.

items.description: One isolation restriction the runner enforces.

ledgerTouching.description: True when the stage mutates the claim ledger, which excludes Windows-class runners.

cpu.description: Stage CPU minimum as a Kubernetes quantity; omitted when undeclared.

memory.description: Stage memory minimum as a Kubernetes quantity; omitted when undeclared.

disk.description: Stage disk minimum as a Kubernetes quantity; omitted when undeclared.

items.description: One isolation restriction the stage requires.

trigger.description: What caused the run to start.

source.description: Origin of the supplied input content.

integrity.description: Provenance grade of this immutable input snapshot.
Provenance grade of this snapshot's content blob.
